bib.title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models

question: Can one open-weight MoE model unify agentic, reasoning and coding abilities at frontier level with fewer parameters?
hypothesis: Deeper, narrower MoE with multi-stage pre/mid-training and expert-iteration post-training yields a parameter-efficient generalist.
contributions: GLM-4.5 (355B/32B active) and GLM-4.5-Air (106B/12B active), hybrid thinking and non-thinking modes
Multi-stage pretraining on 23T tokens plus mid-training to 128K context
Expert model iteration with self-distillation and RL (Slime infrastructure)

method.summary: MoE decoder pretrained on 15T general + 7T code/reasoning-upweighted tokens, mid-trained on repo code, synthetic reasoning and long-context/agent data; post-trained by training reasoning, agent and chat experts (SFT then RL) and distilling them into one hybrid model, then general RL and pathology RL.

datasets.name: General pre-training corpus
datasets.source: English and Chinese web, social media, books, papers, code repositories; Fineweb-2 for multilingual
datasets.preprocessing: Web quality buckets (Nemotron-CC style), top bucket >3.2 epochs, lowest discarded; MinHash plus SemDedup; code quality tiers with FIM on all source code; LLM-scored math/science classifier

datasets.name: Repo-level code data
datasets.source: concatenated repo files, model-filtered issues, PRs, commits

datasets.name: Synthetic reasoning data
datasets.source: questions/answers from web and books with reasoning synthesized by a reasoning model

datasets.name: Long context & agent data
datasets.source: upsampled long documents plus synthetic agent trajectories

datasets.name: Overall SFT data
datasets.source: outputs of expert models: reasoning, chat, agentic, long context

models.name: GLM-4.5
models.architecture: MoE, loss-free balance routing, sigmoid gates, GQA with partial RoPE, QK-Norm, 1 MTP layer

training.objective: next-token (plus Fill-In-the-Middle on code, MTP loss); RL via GRPO without KL term
training.optimizer: Muon for all parameters except word embedding, bias, RMSNorm weights; Newton-Schulz steps 5, momentum 0.95, update RMS scaled to 0.2
training.lr: warm-up 0 to 2.5e-4, decay to 2.5e-5 until end of mid-training
training.batch_size: batch size warmup 16M to 64M tokens over first 500B tokens, then constant
training.precision: BF16 training, FP8 block-wise quantized inference in RL rollouts

other.packing: no best-fit packing in pre-training; best-fit in mid-training
other.dynamic_temperature: next temperature = max value not dropping >1% from current optimum on held-out set

inference.samples: AIME Avg@32, GPQA Avg@8; ablation curves AVG@32
inference.prompting: TAU-bench uses an optimized user-simulator prompt (Fig 11)

other.swe_bench: OpenHands v0.34.0, 100 iterations, history truncation for 128K

metrics.name: Accuracy/EM/Pass@1 on ARC benchmarks
metrics.definition: as per benchmark; AIME Avg@32, GPQA Avg@8; HLE text-only judged by GPT-4o

eval.protocol: Base model: internal framework. Post-trained: open-sourced glm-simple-evals; human evals single evaluator; no seeds or significance tests stated; LiveCodeBench problems 7/1/2024 to 1/1/2025.

availability.data: CC-Bench trajectories on Hugging Face; pretraining and SFT data not released
